about: Drawing-time contract, recorded from jf_core::DisplayClock, next_second_us and next_step_us (core/jf-core/src/timing.rs). Each case starts a new DisplayClock and applies its steps in order: update(anchor, now_ns); position(now_ns) must return expect (µs); wait_until(target_us, now_ns) must return expect_us (µs, null for none); running must equal expect. next_second rows are [position_us, expected]; next_step rows are [position_us, step_us, expected or null]. Generated by core/jf-ffi/tests/drawing_contract.rs; every shell's port replays it.

cases.name: small corrections are slewed, not jumped
a backward correction never moves backwards
seeks, pauses and new tracks show at once
a long run with drift, seeks and pauses
